title: Making holograms with a pen plotter
summary: A maker project demonstrating how to create holographic interference patterns using a pen plotter, a CNC drawing machine typically used for vector graphics on paper. The author explores generating hologram-like visual effects through computational methods and physical plotting techniques.
problem_solved: Makes hologram creation accessible to hobbyists without expensive laser equipment by using a low-cost pen plotter to physically draw interference patterns.
why_valuable: Demonstrates creative DIY applications for common maker tools and bridges the gap between optical physics and accessible fabrication techniques.
